Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC2; US1 AC4; US2 AC4; US5 AC1
Title: Capture principal notebook baseline
Description: Measure and record baseline runtime and relevant execution metrics for the principal coverage notebook using a representative large policy batch.
Preconditions / Test Data: Existing version of coverage_perils_financial_principal is runnable; representative input batch of approximately 100 policies and baseline execution environment are available.
Steps: 1. Record input batch size and execution conditions. 2. Run the existing principal notebook against the prepared batch. 3. Record notebook elapsed time and relevant Spark/job metrics. 4. Save the execution plan or performance evidence with the baseline record.
Expected Results: Baseline execution time and relevant metrics are recorded for the principal notebook with enough workload and environment detail to support a comparable optimized run.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC1; US1 AC3; US1 AC5
Title: Identify bottlenecks in both notebooks
Description: Verify that execution-plan and runtime analysis identifies material bottlenecks in both in-scope notebooks and links findings to proposed changes.
Preconditions / Test Data: Both notebook execution plans and runtime metrics are accessible; representative batch workload is available; analysis results can be recorded.
Steps: 1. Review principal notebook execution plan and runtime metrics. 2. Review occasional notebook execution plan and runtime metrics. 3. Identify material scans, shuffles, joins, filters, queries, transformations, or Spark jobs contributing to elapsed time. 4. Map each proposed optimization to a documented finding.
Expected Results: Analysis covers both notebooks; bottlenecks are supported by execution evidence; proposed changes are traceable to findings; no unsupported optimization assumption is recorded as a measured result.
Validation Layer: Spark execution plan and metrics review

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US2 AC1; US2 AC2; US2 AC3
Title: Run optimized principal notebook
Description: Verify the optimized principal coverage notebook completes successfully and its relevant runtime is measurable.
Preconditions / Test Data: Principal notebook optimization is implemented; matching baseline input batch and comparable execution conditions are available.
Steps: 1. Run the optimized principal notebook with the same input scope as the baseline. 2. Confirm job and notebook completion status. 3. Capture elapsed time and relevant Spark metrics. 4. Compare the run to the principal baseline.
Expected Results: The notebook completes successfully; optimized runtime and relevant metrics are captured; no processing errors prevent output generation.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC2; US2 AC4; US3 AC4; US4 AC1; US5 AC1; US5 AC2; US5 AC3
Title: Measure end-to-end performance for approximately 100 policies
Description: Verify that the complete SQ1 reprocessing flow has a measurable end-to-end runtime reduction after optimizing both notebooks.
Preconditions / Test Data: End-to-end workflow invokes both optimized notebooks; baseline end-to-end duration and per-notebook metrics are recorded; same representative input batch of approximately 100 policies and comparable execution conditions are available.
Steps: 1. Record the batch size and execution conditions. 2. Run the complete optimized SQ1 reprocessing flow for the prepared batch. 3. Record end-to-end duration and each notebook's duration. 4. Compare all durations with the corresponding baseline results.
Expected Results: The end-to-end run completes and its runtime is lower than the comparable baseline; per-notebook and end-to-end timings are documented; no numeric target beyond measurable reduction is assumed.
Validation Layer: Full workflow runtime and Spark metrics

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US4 AC1; US4 AC2; US4 AC3; US4 AC4
Title: Compare principal notebook output with baseline
Description: Confirm the principal notebook optimization preserves its output structure and data for identical inputs.
Preconditions / Test Data: Baseline and optimized principal notebook outputs are retained for the same input data and processing scope; approved output contract and comparison method are available.
Steps: 1. Run or retrieve baseline and optimized principal outputs for identical inputs. 2. Compare schemas and output structure. 3. Compare records and field values at the approved output grain. 4. Investigate any differences against the approved contract.
Expected Results: No unintended schema, record, or value differences are found. Any approved intentional difference is documented and does not violate the output contract.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US4 AC1; US4 AC2; US4 AC3; US4 AC4; US4 AC5; US5 AC5
Title: Validate complete end-to-end data outputs
Description: Verify the optimized workflow produces the same end-to-end policy data as the existing workflow for equivalent inputs.
Preconditions / Test Data: Baseline and optimized complete-workflow outputs are available for the same prepared policy batch; approved schemas, output grain, and comparison rules are available.
Steps: 1. Run or retrieve baseline end-to-end outputs. 2. Run the optimized end-to-end flow using identical source data and scope. 3. Compare output schemas and structure. 4. Compare policy identifiers, records, and values at the approved grain. 5. Record and resolve any discrepancies.
Expected Results: End-to-end output structure and data match the baseline and approved contract with no unexplained differences; validation evidence is retained alongside performance results.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US4 AC1; US4 AC2; US4 AC4
Title: Validate principal premium calculation
Description: Verify that principal coverage premium results remain correct after optimization, without assuming a formula not specified by the story.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared policies cover the supported principal premium scenarios; approved premium calculation rules or business-approved expected results and baseline principal outputs are available.
Steps: 1. Run the baseline and optimized principal notebook for the same prepared policies. 2. Identify the principal premium fields at the approved output grain. 3. Compare optimized premium results with approved expected results and the baseline. 4. Reconcile any difference using the approved calculation rules.
Expected Results: Principal premium results match the approved expected results and baseline for identical inputs; field precision and output representation follow the approved contract; discrepancies are resolved or explicitly approved.
Validation Layer: Principal premium calculation and output validation

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US4 AC1; US4 AC2; US4 AC4; US5 AC5
Title: Validate premiums end to end across both notebooks
Description: Verify end-to-end principal and occasional premium results remain correct when both optimized notebooks run in the SQ1 workflow.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared end-to-end policy batch exercises supported principal and occasional coverage cases; approved premium rules or expected results and baseline workflow outputs are available.
Steps: 1. Run the existing end-to-end workflow and retain premium outputs. 2. Run the optimized workflow with identical input data and scope. 3. Compare principal and occasional premium results separately at the approved grain. 4. Compare any downstream combined or delivered premium field only if specified by the approved output contract. 5. Reconcile differences against approved rules.
Expected Results: Both premium result sets match their approved expected results and baseline; coverage results remain associated with the correct policy and approved output grain; no undocumented aggregation or formula is assumed.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US2 AC1; US2 AC2; US3 AC1; US3 AC2; US4 AC2; US4 AC4
Title: Verify joins and filters preserve eligible data
Description: Check that performance tuning of joins and filtering does not drop, duplicate, or misassociate policy financial output.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared input includes records exercising the existing approved join and filter conditions; baseline outputs and approved eligibility rules are available.
Steps: 1. Run baseline notebooks against the prepared input. 2. Run optimized notebooks against identical input. 3. Compare selected policy and coverage keys, eligible output records, and associated financial or premium values. 4. Investigate records present in only one output or values associated with a different key.
Expected Results: The optimized outputs preserve the baseline's approved eligible records, key associations, and values; no unintended loss, duplication, or reassignment is introduced by join or filter changes.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US2 AC1; US2 AC2; US3 AC1; US3 AC2; US4 AC2; US4 AC4
Title: Verify scan and shuffle optimizations preserve results
Description: Confirm changes made to reduce scans or shuffles improve the intended execution behavior without altering outputs.
Preconditions / Test Data: Execution-plan findings identify a scan or shuffle targeted for optimization; baseline and optimized execution plans and equivalent outputs are available.
Steps: 1. Compare baseline and optimized execution plans and relevant runtime metrics. 2. Verify the targeted scan or shuffle changed as intended. 3. Compare the corresponding notebook outputs for identical inputs. 4. Record any other material plan changes.
Expected Results: The targeted plan behavior reflects the intended optimization; the notebook completes; output data remains equivalent to baseline with no unintended functional change.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US5 AC2; US5 AC4; US5 AC5
Title: Review before-and-after evidence
Description: Verify performance and data-validation evidence is documented clearly enough to demonstrate the outcome to SQ1 stakeholders.
Preconditions / Test Data: Baseline and optimized notebook and end-to-end metrics, batch size, execution conditions, output comparison results, and relevant execution-plan evidence are available.
Steps: 1. Review the before-and-after record for both notebooks and end-to-end execution. 2. Check that batch size and comparison conditions are stated. 3. Verify the measured improvement calculation or comparison is reproducible from recorded timings. 4. Confirm data validation evidence accompanies the performance results.
Expected Results: Documentation includes baseline and optimized timings for each notebook and the full workflow, comparable run conditions, measurable reduction, and output-validation evidence; results can be interpreted and reproduced.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US4 AC5; US5 AC3; US5 AC5
Title: Block acceptance when output differences are unexplained
Description: Verify unexplained functional or data discrepancies are not treated as successful validation solely because runtime improved.
Preconditions / Test Data: A controlled validation run produces a known, unexplained difference between optimized output and baseline or approved expected data; performance results are available.
Steps: 1. Run the optimized workflow and compare outputs with the baseline or approved expected results. 2. Introduce or identify an unexplained output discrepancy in the validation evidence. 3. Review the acceptance result and discrepancy record.
Expected Results: The discrepancy is explicitly investigated and resolved or formally approved before acceptance; a performance improvement alone does not result in a passing functional validation.
